author: sjm41
body:
* **ARBA rule (ID and label):**
ARBA00022603 & ARBA00022679

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Dmel CG18213 (FBgn0038470) (Q9VEP2)
Dmel dao (FBgn0028862) (Q9V3J9)

* **Description of issue**
ARBA00022603 -> KW #[Methyltransferase](https://www.uniprot.org/keywords/KW-0489) -> [methyltransferase activity (GO:0008168)](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/term/GO:0008168)
ARBA00022679 -> KW #[Transferase](https://www.uniprot.org/keywords/KW-0808) -> [transferase activity (GO:0016740)](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/QuickGO/term/GO:0016740)

Both these ARBAs are associated with both Dmel genes based on the sole presence of:
InterPro signature [IPR052097](https://www.ebi.ac.uk/interpro/entry/IPR052097) SET and MYND domain-containing protein

However, these two proteins actually lack a SET domain, and are not catalytically active. 
Also, IPR052097 has no GO annotations itself.
title: ARBA2GO issue: ARBA00022603 & ARBA00022679

author: sjm41
body:
These Dmel genes/proteins also get incorrect 'transferase activity' KW and GO via [ARBA00022679](https://www.uniprot.org/arba/ARBA00022679)

trio (FBgn0024277) (Q7KVD1) = guanine exchange factor, not a transferase enzyme
- not sure why this matches

CG18605 (FBgn0034411) (A0A0B4JD40) = related to E3 ligase, but lacks a RING finger domain to be active
- FunFam match?

CG10702 (FBgn0032752) (Q9VJ04) = lacks a kinase domain, so not a kinase/transferase
- InterPro signature	IPR000494:Receptor L-domain
- InterPro signature	IPR006211:Furin-like cysteine-rich domain
- InterPro signature	IPR009030:Growth factor receptor cysteine-rich domain superfamily

CG31431 (FBgn0051431) (Q8IN19) = lacks a kinase domain, so not a kinase/transferase
- FunFam match?

morgue (FBgn0027609) (Q9Y165) = E2 conjugating pseudoenzyme, has 'NOT ubiquitin conjugating enzyme activity' annotation
- FunFam match?

author: Antonialock
body:
Thanks for reporting this Steven. I have annotated protein dao, so the kw's will disappear from entries by matching with IPR052097 in release 26_03 .

A0A0B4JD40/Topors-like protein &  Q9VJ04/Protein CG10702 were already reported other tickets, I have annotated these already so just waiting for the update to trickle through to ARBA (hopefully 26_02)



trio gets it from matching
InterPro signature
    IPR000219
    IPR001251
    IPR028570
trio has been published, I will curate this protein

CG31431 (FBgn0051431) (Q8IN19)  gets it from 2.60.40.10:FF:000020 I'll see what I can do about this.

morgue (FBgn0027609) (Q9Y165) this is from 3.10.110.10:FF:000060, which is associated with an eclectic mix of protein names,
https://www.uniprot.org/uniprotkb?query=%28xref%3A%22funfam-3.10.110.10%3AFF%3A000060%22%29
 so there might be other issues I'll open a new ticket for this to look at this in more detail.
